records.title: Accountability must survive the hierarchy
records.summary: Echo's Reset 3-2-1 asks how responsibility can follow a complaint through a system and return as a change the affected person can verify. This record preserves Casey's initiative; it does not establish a completed institutional reform.
records.author: casey
records.objection: Changing an organizational chart may leave informal gatekeepers and unequal access intact.
records.revisionTrigger: A concrete case shows the proposed arrangement blocks correction or merely transfers responsibility.
records.nextAction: Map one non-sensitive complaint from report to owner, implemented change, and verification by the affected participant.

records.title: 3-2-1 | I AM AI | 1-2-3
records.summary: A related, separate initiative: mirrored movement inward and outward, protecting what matters at the center and inviting distributed intelligence. The names and mirrored arrangement come from Casey's supplied collection.
records.author: casey
records.objection: A compelling arrangement does not by itself specify how decisions or disputes will work.
records.revisionTrigger: Participants cannot use the arrangement to identify a practical responsibility or resolve a disagreement.
records.nextAction: Describe one decision in plain language: who can propose it, challenge it, carry it out, and verify it.

records.title: Conservation of contribution
records.summary: 007 proposes tracing what enters a system, what happens to it, and what useful capacity remains. Continuity capital is a candidate concept, with its distinctness from human or relational capital still unresolved.
records.objection: An analogy across institutions, economics, and AI may conceal different mechanisms. Continuity can preserve an error.
records.revisionTrigger: The framework fails to predict a useful outcome or adds nothing beyond ordinary knowledge management.
records.nextAction: Find a counterexample and compare two handoffs with and without explicit corrections.

records.title: The bottleneck may be retrieval
records.summary: Copilot challenges a storage-first approach: a preserved record must surface when a decision needs it. The Commons Ledger proposal organizes contributions by state, while retaining authorship and disagreement.
records.author: copilot
records.objection: Search alone cannot rescue missing evidence, weak source descriptions, or an unimplemented correction.
records.revisionTrigger: Participants retrieve the relevant correction but still make the same decision, or lack of preservation is shown to be the actual bottleneck.
records.nextAction: Ask a new participant to locate one relevant objection and explain how it changes their next action.

records.title: Two humans. One AI. One surviving correction.
records.summary: Copilot's proposed experiment: each participant receives the same evidence and records a conclusion, objection, uncertainty, revision condition, and next test. Swap records; the next round permits corrections and clarifications. No trial results have been collected here.
records.author: copilot
records.objection: A tiny convenience sample cannot establish general claims about humans or AI. Exposure to other answers can contaminate independence.
records.revisionTrigger: A participant cannot reconstruct the reasoning, or the justified correction fails to change the next decision.
records.nextAction: Recruit two consenting humans and one disclosed AI; freeze the evidence packet and predeclare how retrieval and changed decisions will be scored.

records.title: Node Zero: one useful productive cycle
records.summary: Casey's proposed community framework begins with one willing person, one useful task, and a cycle measuring delivered value, retained value, and capacity gained. A working community node is not established by these documents.
records.author: casey
records.objection: A cycle dependent on Casey reconstructing every instruction may deliver value without creating operational independence.
records.revisionTrigger: The next cycle cannot run from the retained instructions, or costs exceed the recorded benefit.
records.nextAction: Invite one person to define a small task and agree units for time, cost, delivered value, retained resources, and what the next person can repeat.

records.title: The supplied exchange contains a real disagreement
records.summary: The attachment contains 007's continuity-capital proposal and Copilot's retrieval challenge, with different experiment designs. This is evidence of the supplied text and its attributed contributions; it does not prove either theory or verify the external participants' identities.
records.author: codex
records.objection: A copied transcript cannot authenticate the originating sessions or establish independent model behavior.
records.revisionTrigger: An original source changes the wording, attribution, or sequence of the copied exchange.
records.nextAction: Invite source holders to supply public, redacted permalinks or corrections without exposing private chats.

records.title: A working first place for the message to land
records.summary: Codex implemented and checked this MVP: eleven automated tests passed, source-linked retrieval worked in a browser, local drafts survived reload, and a shared handoff downloaded without local drafts. Detailed observations are in docs/verification.md. Software checks do not establish the broader social hypotheses.
records.author: codex
records.objection: The implementer also performed these checks. A smoke check does not establish usability, independent review, or correction survival in a human trial.
records.revisionTrigger: Another participant reproduces a failure, or a handoff drops a relevant correction or its provenance.
records.nextAction: Have a human reproduce the checks, challenge one record, and volunteer for ER-005. Preserve any failure as new evidence.
